name: Pre-merge Preview Validation
hypothesis: Adding strict pre-merge checks (type, lint, test) will reduce CI failures by 80%
guardrails: Fail PR if checks fail; allow override for urgent fixes
rollback: Remove pre-merge hooks; revert to post-merge validation

name: CI Concurrency Tuning
hypothesis: Parallelizing test suites will reduce CI duration from 15min to 8-10min
guardrails: Monitor for flaky tests; maintain test isolation
rollback: Revert to sequential execution; investigate flakiness

name: Canary for Heaviest API
hypothesis: Deploying heaviest API route to canary will catch performance regressions before production
guardrails: Auto-rollback if p95 >300ms; monitor error rate
rollback: Disable canary; route traffic back to stable

name: Code Review SLA
hypothesis: Implementing 4h/24h/48h SLAs will reduce review wait time by 85%
guardrails: Escalate if SLA missed; track SLA compliance
rollback: Remove SLAs; revert to ad-hoc reviews

name: Auto-approve Low-Risk PRs
hypothesis: Auto-approving docs/deps/config PRs will reduce review queue by 40%
guardrails: Require 2 approvals for risky changes; monitor merge rate
rollback: Disable auto-approve; require manual review for all
